strength.label: Destination charging
strength.text: The Australian Series 1 guide lists 11 kW AC charging and a standard Mode 3 cable, useful for regular destination charging with suitable compatible equipment.

tradeoff.label: Puncture planning
tradeoff.text: The Series 1 Elettrica catalogue supplies a tyre-repair kit and marks the compact spare unavailable.

conditions: Australian Alfa Romeo Junior Elettrica FWD, Series 1 catalogue; manufacturer model year unverified. The catalogue evidence does not certify a current production build or the separate N58772 advertisement.
The 11 kW AC figure requires suitable compatible supply and charging equipment; charging time varies with conditions.
Equipment statements follow the Series 1 Elettrica column. N58772 fitment, physical availability, manufacturer MY and warranty commencement have not been factory-verified.
